Brief_evidence: Germline, in cis with R938Q, in a hereditary thrombocytosis family. S755R/R938Q drives spontaneous Ba/F3-MPL growth and TPO-independent STAT1 phosphorylation; longer half-life and LESS sensitive to JAK2 and HSP90 inhibitors than V617F.
Notes: LISTED AS R755S. Position 755 of O60674/NP_004963.1 is Ser, so R755S cannot exist; the variant is S755R (transposed), confirmed by Marty 2014 Blood, which reports S755R in cis with R938Q - and R938Q and R867Q from the same paper are both in this list. ClinVar has p.Ser755Arg as VUS (multiple submitters, no conflicts). NOT R683S: that was an earlier wrong guess of mine.
